description: Logical calls of function / arbitrary waveform generators (one or more output channels). The amplitude is the peak-to-peak value the instrument is set to produce; what the circuit under test sees also depends on the output load setting of the instrument, which the application does not change.

bool.description: true/false; default text sent to the instrument is ON/OFF unless the library gives a map

waveform_shape.description: waveform of an output; a model accepts the ones its manual lists (the others are not handled by this model, CALL-002)

set_output_state.description: switch an output on or off; a measurement switches the outputs off before it starts and when it ends, also after an error

channel_number.description: output channel (1-based); ignored by single-output generators

set_frequency.description: frequency of the waveform of an output
